pr_title: Fix issues with swisscom router integration
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Fixing the broken swisscom router integration. See [#87220](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/87220)

- new default ip is "internetbox.swisscom.ch"
- new default protocol is `https` #82789

fixing #87220
- retrieving devices requires router password since firmware update to 13.20.26/13.20.18
- solution is to open a session with the router using a two-step process
  - first, the session is created to authenticate and get a session id and context
  - second, using these values, the list of devices can be retrieved

issue_context.title: Swisscom integration is broken with latest Internetbox Firmware release
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since the latest release of the Swisscom firmware  13.20.26/13.20.18 the device lookup is not possible anymore.

From debugging the response there seems to be some authentication required as the error code is 13 with text of Permission denied

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2023.2.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Device Tracker, Swisscom

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/swisscom/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

@Danit2 

The file to replace is in this zip file here:
[device_tracker.zip](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/10942305/device_tracker.zip)

- Simply replace the one in `homeassistant\components\swisscom` with the attached copy (backup first 😉 )
- Add your router's admin password into the HA configuration using a [secret](https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/configuration/secrets/)
```
device_tracker:
  - platform: swisscom
    host: internetbox.swisscom.ch
    password: !secret swisscom_router_password
```
- Reboot HA and it should start detecting the available devices again.
